snippet.title: Long Play - The Punisher (MS-DOS)
snippet.description:
Paragon Software released several games based on Marvel Comics titles, and this was without a doubt the best!

This was also the very first game I got when my father brought home an 80386 PC back in the day, and I had beaten it countless times.

There's not a lot of information or YouTube videos made for this game, and I am happy to present this game for all to see, from beginning to end all the way to the final battle against the Kingpin!

It may not be much in terms of graphics or audio, but it really captures the essence of the Punisher perfectly.

Plus other characters like Bullseye, Jigsaw, and Typhoid Mary make appearances!

Recorded with OBS Studio https://obsproject.com
Emulator: DOSBox

My emulation gear:
CPU: Intel Core i3-7100U 2.4GHz
GPU: Intel HD 620
RAM: 16GB DDR4 2133MHz
Frontend: Launchbox https://www.launchbox-app.com
